title: One evidence record: reconcile job-protocol.json records.evidence with ticfac-run-state.json evidence_envelope
description: Surfaced by the wave-2 merge (x1w RESULT, measured: 22 validation errors). Bundle 1.2.0 describes the same file, .ticfac/runs/<run-id>/evidence/<key>.json, with two incompatible shapes: job-protocol.json records.evidence is flat and closed (15 provenance fields top-level, additionalProperties false, check/output/persistence_uri, acceptance in {required, advisory}); ticfac-run-state.json evidence_envelope requires a nested provenance object plus key and is open past those. Both suites are green only because each validates its own examples. DECISION (orchestrator, logged on this tick): the nested shape is canonical — one $defs.provenance object shared by checkpoint, attempt, decision and evidence, as run-state already does — and the evidence record is defined ONCE, in job-protocol.json, closed (additionalProperties false, SPEC §10.1 bounded and redacted), with key, check, output, persistence_uri and acceptance vocabulary reconciled; ticfac-run-state.json references that single definition rather than carrying its own. Work: rewrite records.evidence to the nested-provenance shape; make job_result reference it; delete evidence_envelope from run-state and point to job-protocol (by schema_id, with a cross-file golden test that validates the run-state golden evidence example against records.evidence and vice versa — the test that would have caught this); update goldens/negatives in both files; both Go readers (internal/factory/jobprotocol, internal/factory/runstate) and both TS readers; the bundle bump follows contracts/CHANGELOG.md rule for a changed shape (MAJOR: 2.0.0) with the pin moved; SPEC §10.1 and §10.4 name the one record. Also add a cross-contract test that every schema_id appearing in more than one contract file resolves to exactly one definition.
notes: 2026-09-02 14:48 - decision: Which evidence shape is canonical: job-protocol flat/closed or run-state nested provenance? → Nested provenance, defined once in job-protocol.json, closed; run-state references it — One shared provenance def is already what checkpoint/attempt/decision use; a record defined in two files is the drift the bundle exists to prevent. Reversible: lands behind the epic PR gate. [class:naming, internal API shape, file layout]
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one evidence schema exists in the bundle and both contracts reference it; a cross-file test validates each contract golden evidence example against the single definition from both Go and TypeScript; make contracts-bundle-check, go test ./internal/contracts/ ./internal/factory/jobprotocol/ ./internal/factory/runstate/, pnpm contracts:check, pnpm contracts:test, pnpm exec tsc --noEmit and the two vitest reader files pass; bundle version bumped per the changelog rule with the pin moved; SPEC references updated.
